name: Night Light
description: A bedtime night light for a child's room. As a screensaver it shows a dim warm night light. Press Soother for gentle sleepy music or sounds while the screen drifts through soft colours, which then fades back to the night light.
author: heazlewood

settings.title: Soother length
settings.description: How long the soother plays before it fades back to the night light.

settings.title: Soother sound
settings.description: What the soother plays. The music box lullaby is made up as it plays, so it never repeats exactly. Brahms & Mozart plays Brahms' Lullaby and Twinkle, Twinkle on the music box. Thunderstorm is rain with distant thunder now and then. White noise is a steady hiss, pink noise is softer and brown noise is a deep rumble.

settings.title: Soother volume
settings.description: How loud the soother plays, on top of the device's media volume.

settings.title: Soother colours
settings.description: The set of colours the soother drifts through.

settings.title: Colour style
settings.description: How the soother looks. Glow is one soft glow that drifts through the colours. Liquid is a few soft blobs of colour that slowly drift and blend into each other. The night light has its own style.

settings.title: Colour speed
settings.description: How quickly one colour melts into the next.

settings.title: Colour brightness
settings.description: How bright the soother colours are. They also dim a little as the soother goes on.

settings.title: Fade to night light
settings.description: How long the soother takes to fade into the night light when it finishes by itself. End fades it in about 20 seconds.

settings.title: Night light style
settings.description: How the night light looks. Flat is one even colour across the screen. Glow is a soft glow, brighter in the middle. Liquid is a few soft blobs of colour that drift very slowly and blend, like the soother's liquid style but much slower.

settings.title: Night light colours
settings.description: Solid is one steady night light colour. Or pick a set of colours, the same sets as the soother's, to drift through very slowly, just as dim.

settings.title: Night light colour
settings.description: A warm orange or amber is kindest to sleep.

settings.title: Night light brightness
settings.description: How bright the night light glows.

settings.title: Night light sound
settings.description: What plays with the night light all night, including when the screensaver first starts. The same choices as the soother, picked separately. The soother fades into it.

settings.title: Night light volume
settings.description: How loud the night light sound plays, separate from the soother, on top of the device's media volume.

settings.title: Keep sound when closed
settings.description: Keeps the sound playing after the screensaver closes, for example when the screen is touched or turns off. Stop night light sound or Close Night Light ends it.

settings.title: Sound on
settings.description: On while the sound plays without the screensaver. Turn it on or off here to play or stop the sound.

settings.title: Resume sound after restart
settings.description: If the sound was on when the device or Kiosk Satellite restarted, for example after a power cut, plays it again.

settings.title: Sound fade
settings.description: Seconds the sound takes to fade in when it starts and to fade out when it stops. Also a number in Home Assistant.

settings.title: Bedtime countdown
settings.description: Shows a row of stars on the night light, about one per hour of sleep. They go out one by one, so your child can see how long until up time.

settings.title: Bed time
settings.description: When the night starts and every star is lit, such as 19:00 or 7pm.

settings.title: Up time
settings.description: When the last star goes out and it is time to get up, such as 07:00 or 7am. At most 10 stars show.

settings.title: Night mode
settings.description: Recolours the button, hint, stars and Kiosk Satellite's widgets when the room gets dark, like the Clock screensaver's Night mode. Needs a device with a light sensor.

settings.title: Light level
settings.description: Night mode starts at or below this light level, and ends a little above it so the colours never flicker.

settings.title: Night color
settings.description: The colour of the button, hint, stars and widgets in the dark. Muted red by default, which is kindest to sleepy eyes.

settings.title: Hide button and stars
settings.description: Hides the button, hint and stars while Night mode is on, leaving only the night light. They come back when the room brightens. A double tap still closes the screensaver.
